result.instructions: Tools for TimeStation, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is currently clocked in, and in which department?"; "Show me John's shifts for last week and his total minutes."; "Run the AttendanceOnly report for 1 to 15 November.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TimeStation data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timestation_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timestation_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timestation_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timestation_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timestation_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List all employees in the TimeStation account with their current status (in/out), primary and current department, and custom employee id. Good first call. GET /employees.

tools.name: timestation_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get the details of one employee, including status, departments, and custom fields. GET /employees/{employee_id}.

tools.name: timestation_list_employee_departments
tools.title: List an employee's departments
tools.description: List the departments an employee belongs to (primary and secondary). GET /employees/{employee_id}/departments.

tools.name: timestation_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List all departments in the TimeStation account. GET /departments.

tools.name: timestation_get_department
tools.title: Get a department
tools.description: Get the details of one department. GET /departments/{department_id}.

tools.name: timestation_list_shifts
tools.title: List an employee's shifts
tools.description: List the shifts of one employee (check-in and check-out times, total minutes, notes), optionally within a date range. GET /shifts.

tools.name: timestation_get_shift
tools.title: Get a shift
tools.description: Get the details of one shift, including its check-in and check-out times. GET /shifts/{shift_id}.

tools.name: timestation_run_report
tools.title: Run a report
tools.description: Run a TimeStation report and return it as CSV (first row is the header). Examples: AttendanceOnly, CurrentEmployeeStatus, DepartmentList, DepartmentSummary, DailyAttendanceAbsence (use day_date). Pass start_date and end_date for date-range reports. GET /reports/{report_id}.

tools.name: timestation_create_employee
tools.title: Create an employee
tools.description: Create a new employee. Provide department_id or department_name (a new department is created when the name is unknown). Creates a record: this is not idempotent. POST /employees.

department_id.description: Existing primary department id. Give this or department_name.

department_name.description: Primary department name. Give this or department_id.

custom_employee_id.description: Second employee id, for a record in another system.

custom_fields.description: Existing employee custom fields, by field name.

tools.name: timestation_check_out_employee
tools.title: Check out an employee
tools.description: Check out an employee: close the employee's current open shift at time_out (or now). It acts on whatever shift is open, so do not retry blindly after a success. PUT /employees/{employee_id}/check-out.

time_out.description: Check-out time, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2025-07-12T17:00-05:00). Omit for the current time.

time_deduction_minutes.description: Minutes to deduct from the shift. Overrides the automatic deduction rules for this shift.

tools.name: timestation_close_shift
tools.title: Close a shift
tools.description: Close an open shift at time_out (or now). PUT /shifts/{shift_id}/close.

time_out.description: Check-out time, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2025-07-12T17:00-05:00). Omit for the current time.

time_deduction_minutes.description: Minutes to deduct from the shift. Overrides the automatic deduction rules for this shift.
